flowKind: A flow is a chain of steps that sends saved requests. Kinds of step are named in the editor and on the canvas.
flowKind.request.label: Step that sends a saved request.
flowKind.set.label: Step that stores values in variables.
flowKind.if.label: Step that branches on a condition.
flowKind.forEach.label: Step that repeats its inner steps for every item of a list.
flowKind.delay.label: Step that waits for a while.
flowKind.end.label: Step that finishes the flow as passed or failed.
flowField: Labels of the connections that leave a step. They are followed by the name of the next step.
flowEngine: Messages produced while a flow is checked or run. They appear in the run summary.
flowEngine.unknownKind: Kind names (request, set, if, forEach, delay, end) are identifiers and stay as written.
flowEngine.unknownTarget: {{field}} is one of the connection labels (Then go to, When it fails go to, ...) and {{target}} the step id.
flowEngine.intoLoop: {{field}} is one of the connection labels and {{target}} the step id. For each is the name of a step kind.
flowEngine.noSource: JSONPath expressions such as $.token stay as written.
flowEngine.problem: {{title}} is the step title and {{message}} one of the other messages.
flowEngine.cannotRun: Count of problems that stop the flow from running.
flowEngine.budget: {{count}} requests were sent; {{cap}} is the highest limit that can be set.
flowEngine.endless: {{count}} steps were visited in a row without sending a request.
flowEngine.timedOut: {{seconds}} is a number of seconds followed by the unit s.
flowEngine.attemptPassedOf: A step that retries passed; {{attempt}} of {{attempts}}.
flowEngine.attemptFailedOf: A step that retries failed on its last attempt.
flowEngine.retrying: Shown when a step failed an attempt and will be tried again.
flowEngine.rerouted: {{target}} is the title of a step, or the end of the flow.
flowEngine.branch: {{branch}} is True or False, the result of an If step; {{target}} is the title of the next step.
flowEngine.endOfFlow: Used inside sentences such as Failed; going to the end of the flow. Keep lower case.
flowEngine.nextItem: Used inside sentences such as True, going to the next item. Keep lower case.
flowEngine.iteration: {{position}} of {{count}} for the current item in a For each step.
flowEngine.waited: {{duration}} is a duration such as 500 ms.
flowEngine.untilCheck: Prefix of the name of a retry condition in the check results, for example until res.status equals 200.
flowImport.missingRequests: Shown after importing a flow whose steps point at requests that are not part of the import.
flowTemplate: Text of the example flow created from Start from an example. Users edit it afterwards.
flowTemplate.waitForOrder: Label of a step that sends a request again until the order status is ready.
flow.sidebarTab: Tab of the sidebar that lists flows.
flow.newName: Default name of a new flow; saved with the flow.
flow.exampleName: Default name of the example flow; saved with the flow.
flow.copyName: Name given to a duplicate: {{name}} followed by copy.
flow.remove: Menu item that deletes the flow.
flow.steps: Number of steps in a flow.
flow.count: Number of flows, for example in a count badge.
flow.tabLabel: Accessible name of a flow tab.
flow.noCurl: Shown instead of a curl command when the copy action is used on a flow.
flow.emptyDescription: gostman flow run is a command line and stays as written.
flowCanvas: Text on the diagram of a flow.
flowCanvas.stepLabel: Accessible name of a step node, for example Step 2 of 5: Send request, Log in.
flowCanvas.stepLabelWithState: Same, with the run state as the last part: running, passed, failed.
flowCanvas.insert: Tooltip of the plus button between two steps.
flowCanvas.retry: Short line on a step that tries again until it passes.
flowCanvas.retryApart: {{delay}} is the wait between attempts, for example 2 s.
flowCanvas.retryShort: Compact badge: retry times 3. The multiplication sign stays.
flowCanvas.until: Line on a step: it retries until this condition holds.
flowCanvas.untilMore: The same with other conditions that are not shown.
flowCanvas.sets: A variable name, an arrow and its source, for example token <- Log in body.
flowCanvas.fromResponse: Source of a value: the title of a step followed by body, header or status.
flowCanvas.conditionAnd: First condition and the number of further conditions that must all pass.
flowCanvas.conditionOr: First condition and the number of further conditions of which one must pass.
flowCanvas.variablesCondition: A condition that checks variables instead of a response.
flowCanvas.loop: {{path}} is a JSONPath, for example $.items; the list is taken from the response of the step {{title}}.
flowCanvas.loopBody: Label of the container that holds the repeated steps.
flowCanvas.nextItem: Label of the connection that returns to the start of the loop.
flowCanvas.wait: {{duration}} is a duration such as 2 s.
flowCanvas.edges: Short labels on the lines between steps.
flowCanvas.toEnd: Label of a line that ends the flow; the arrow stays.
flowCanvas.attempt: Attempt number out of the attempts, for example 2/5.
flowCanvas.visits: How many times the step ran, for example x3.
flowCanvas.problem: Tooltip of the warning icon on a step that has a problem.
flowCanvas.states: Accessible run state of a step.
flowPicker: Dialog that picks the saved request a step sends.
flowEditor.stepId: Technical identifier of a step; other steps refer to it.
flowEditor.variablesHint: {{variables}} is the literal text of a variable placeholder with double braces and {{example}} an example of a loop variable; keep both parameters.
flowEditor.until: Heading of the conditions that decide whether a retrying step passed.
flowEditor.paths: Heading of the section that chooses the next steps.
flowEditor.afterLoop: Label of the field that picks the step after the last item of a loop.
flowEditor.failFlow: Option: stop the flow and mark it failed.
flowEditor.responseOf: Label before the picker of the step whose response is checked.
flowEditor.responseConditionHint: res.status, res.body.field and res.headers.name are expressions and stay as written.
flowEditor.loopHint: {{item}}, {{field}} and {{index}} are the literal variable placeholders of the loop with double braces; keep the parameters.
flowEditor.valuesHint: Extract rules is the name of another feature.
flowEditor.templatePlaceholder: {{example}} is a variable placeholder with double braces.
flowEditor.headerPlaceholder: Example of a response header name; this is the header Location.
flowEditor.milliseconds: Unit label of a number field.
flowView.start: Label of the first node of the diagram, where the flow begins.
flowView.maxSends: Highest number of requests one run may send.
flowView.selectHint: The plus sign is the add button.
flowView.problems: Count of problems shown above the editor.
flowView.cliHint: Followed by a command line, which stays in English.
flowRun.idleHint: Run is the name of the button.
flowRun.wrote: Label before the variables a step stored.
flowRun.hidden: Shown instead of a secret value.
flowScript: Reasons shown when a script skips or stops a request.
flowScript.skipped: A script of the request asked to skip it.
flowScript.stopped: A script asked to stop the whole run.
flow.open: Menu item that opens a flow. Verb.
flow.rename: Menu item that renames a flow. Verb.
flow.duplicate: Menu item that makes a copy of a flow. Verb.
flow.save: Button that saves a flow. Verb.
flowView.run: Button that runs the flow. Verb.
flowView.stop: Button that stops a running flow. Verb.
flowView.save: Button that saves the flow. Verb.
flowView.runTab: Name of the tab that shows the result of running the flow. Noun.
flowView.description: Label of the field for the description of a flow. Noun.
